The example of the repository: one `[4, 1]` weight, a batch of 8 rows of 4 features, mean squared error and plain SGD. `task check-examples` checks it on every change, and the tests of `modelspec-cli` hold its IR and its training run.

The output below was recorded by `modelspec-docs` running the `modelspec` command line on the model; `task docs-check` fails when a run prints anything else.

## The model

[`examples/linear_regression.mspec`](https://github.com/beyond10x/modelspec/blob/main/examples/linear_regression.mspec):

```modelspec
model LinearReg {
    param w: Tensor<f32, [4, 1]> = xavier_uniform();

    fn forward(x: Tensor<f32, [8, 4]>)
        -> Tensor<f32, [8, 1]> {
        return matmul(x, w);
    }
}

train Fit {
    model = LinearReg;
    input x: Tensor<f32, [8, 4]>;
    target y: Tensor<f32, [8, 1]>;
    loss = mse(model.forward(x), y);
    optimizer = sgd(lr = 0.1);
    steps = 500;
    seed = 42;
    device = cpu;
}
```
